title: geo_map point record
description: One point for tools/geo_map.py (capability viz.geo_map). Columns with other names are ported via the tool's `mapping` option, e.g. {"lat": "latitude", "weight": "visit_count"}. Unknown extra columns are carried into popups verbatim.

id.description: Unique row id; defaults to row index

label.description: Display name / address for popups. Leave empty and pass geocode=true to fill via OSM Nominatim.

weight.description: Numeric magnitude (e.g. visit count) — drives marker size and the min-weight filter

group.description: Categorical bucket — drives marker color, legend, and the group filter (first 8 groups get distinct colors)

first_seen.description: Earliest timestamp — enables the date-range filter
